Cornucopians, 

We are excited to share that we have made incredible progress in developing our Node program. Over the last 6 months, our team has been exploring options, and developing/testing prototypes. We now have a working prototype of an infrastructure “file node” that will be operational in 2024. That said, we will be kicking off our first node sale beginning as soon as Friday, December 15th. Here are some basic bits of information:



Every node license will be officially issued as an NFT. The NFT will function as an activation key for your node through player accounts
,
This will be a multi-chain sale, starting with Cardano being the first sale
,
This will be a multi-tier sale, with a diminishing supply per tier and increasing price per tier
,
To qualify for Cardano Tier 1, you can purchase a Tier 1 whitelist with Corn Points. Tier 1 will be the lowest entry price for these nodes!
,
This will be an ongoing sale that will end once sold out or when the file node product launches
,
Additional details regarding node pricing, supply, operation, and rewards, will be released closer to the sale.
,

Please stay tuned for a recorded demo of the node prototype that will be released in the next few days.

@everyone

In preparation for the sale, here is some additional account information you need to be aware of:

Cornucopias has had two distinct types of accounts.
Player Account that allows you to gain access for testing and game play.
Marketplace Account which allows you to participate in our Mints.

We have been working to integrate these two accounts.
If you have both accounts and they have the same email address, they will be automatically linked.
,
If you have both accounts and they use different email addresses, the old marketplace account settings and history will be lost, but everything will work as normal.
,
If you only have a marketplace account, head over to https://cornucopias.io/register and create an account. Again if you use the same email address as your marketplace account they will be linked.
,
If you only have a player account (https://cornucopias.io/), you simple need to head over to the marketplace and setup the account (see below).
,

MINTING ON MONDAY?
We recommend logging into your account NOW on the marketplace (https://nft.cornucopias.io/), click the "Get Ready" link in the dropdown menu (hover on the avatar icon) and ensure your account is ready.

NEW TO CORNUCOPIAS?
If you do not have an account with cornucopias, you only need to set up one on https://cornucopias.io/register 
That single account will handle all of your future logins.

2FA DISCLAIMER:
We highly recommend 2FA, however: 
If you set up 2FA on your account, please ensure that you back up the recovery info. We cannot assist you should you lose access to due to 2FA recovery not being backed up.

Here is how the Tier 1 B raffle will work (for those of you that have participated in past sales, this will be familiar to you)... 

The sale will start at 8pm UTC and it will open with a 5 minute raffle window. This is your best chance to mint in the event there are more people participating than the remaining amount of nodes. IF there are any remaining nodes after the raffle window closes, those nodes will sell on a first come first served basis. Obviously, you will want to do your best to enter the raffle. 

Why can't you open the raffle window for a longer period of time?
The reason we can't have the raffle window open for an extended period of time is because we run a high risk of transactions timing out. For the best user experience, we have decided to take our typical 10 second raffle window, and extend it to 5 minutes. 

Due to the short raffle window, it's best that you are prepared and understand how the process works. We have a tutorial video that you can watch here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JnIzA0ihyKM
